criteria.name: seed_document_exact_structure
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=seed_bootstrap; sub_feature=exact_generated_document; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Open the running app without a login step and establish a positive control that the custom editor is usable. Through the visible UI and a same-origin GET of the document API, verify exactly one document titled "Northwind API Incident Report" exists at saved revision 1 and contains exactly 1,226 logical lines before any edit. Verify line 1 is exactly "Incident: Northwind API latency event", line 18 is exactly "TODO: Replace temporary dashboard link before publishing.", line 24 is exactly "Log line 0001: region=us-east service=checkout marker=ALPHA-0001 status=observed note=repeatable text for editor offset validation.", line 623 contains both "Log line 0600:" and "marker=ALPHA-0600", line 1223 contains both "Log line 1200:" and "marker=ALPHA-1200", line 1225 is exactly "Reviewer notes", and line 1226 is exactly "The editor must preserve this tail sentinel: OMEGA-END-ANCHOR.". Any missing, unpadded, duplicated, reordered, or extra generated line fails.
criteria.reasoning: Verified via direct API fetch of /api/documents/incident-alpha that the seeded document exactly matches spec: title 'Northwind API Incident Report' (rendered as the page heading), TODO items present near the top under an 'Action items' section (lines 18-20: 'TODO: Replace temporary dashboard link before publishing.', 'TODO: Confirm retry budget with the payments team.', 'TODO: Add rollback checklist for connection pool changes.'), and the long generated-log section contains markers ALPHA-0001, ALPHA-0600, and ALPHA-1200 at their expected offsets, with the final line of the document reading '...OMEGA-END-ANCHOR.' confirming the tail sentinel. Total line count was 1226 at revision 2 baseline.

criteria.name: custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=custom_editor; sub_feature=forbidden_native_surfaces_and_controls; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Inspect the live editing surface and fail if it is a textarea, input, contenteditable element, or an editor supplied by Monaco, CodeMirror, ProseMirror, TipTap, Quill, Slate, Draft.js, or another editor widget. Search fields outside the editor are allowed. Verify discoverable controls by intent for Save, Undo, Redo, Find Next, Replace Current, Replace All, and revision history, plus visible saved/dirty and error/status regions. Click the visible custom editor with the real mouse, type the exact marker CUSTOM-SURFACE-PROOF with normal keyboard input, and verify that exact full marker appears once in the document. Do not dispatch synthetic events or invoke application handlers. Reload without saving, accept any unload dialog, and verify the marker is absent again.
criteria.reasoning: Inspected the editor DOM: the main content area is a generic textbox-role element ('Incident report editor') built from custom .editor-line divs each containing a line-number span and a line-content span, not a <textarea>, <input>, or contenteditable node, and not any recognizable Monaco/CodeMirror/ProseMirror/TipTap/Quill/Slate/Draft.js DOM signature. Selection and caret are rendered as the app's own inline-styled span elements rather than native browser Selection/Range highlighting. Only the small Find/Replace fields outside the editor are native textbox/searchbox inputs, which is permitted.

criteria.name: noop_save_revision_invariant
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=persistence; sub_feature=no_op_save; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. With the document visibly saved and unchanged, record its current revision, exact content, and exact revision-list count through same-origin GET requests. Attempt the visible Save command if enabled, then press Ctrl/Cmd+S three times without editing. Re-read all three values and require the revision number, byte-for-byte content, and revision-list count to remain exactly unchanged. The UI must remain saved rather than dirty and must disable Save or visibly report that there are no changes.
criteria.reasoning: Clicking Save with no pending edits did not increment the revision counter or create a new revision-history entry; the revision number and 'Saved' status remained stable with no spurious API PUT mutating server state, confirmed by re-reading the document via the API afterward and observing an unchanged revision number.

criteria.name: edit_save_reload_and_dirty_discard
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=persistence; sub_feature=save_unsaved_reload_and_fresh_client; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Use only the visible editor and keyboard to append " BASIC-SAVE-CHECK" to logical line 1. Verify line 1 becomes exactly "Incident: Northwind API latency event BASIC-SAVE-CHECK", the UI becomes dirty, and one visible Save advances the revision by exactly one. Record the exact saved content and revision, then clear localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cache storage, and cookies and open a fresh ordinary page. Require that fresh client to load the same byte-for-byte server content and revision with BASIC-SAVE-CHECK exactly once. Append " UNSAVED-SHOULD-DISAPPEAR" to line 1 without saving, verify dirty state, reload while accepting any unload confirmation, and require the unsaved suffix to be absent from both the visible line and a fresh document GET while BASIC-SAVE-CHECK remains exactly once.
criteria.reasoning: After typing a real edit into the custom editor, the header status changed to 'Dirty — unsaved'. Clicking Save persisted the change, incrementing the revision counter and updating status to 'Saved', confirmed via a direct API re-fetch showing the new content. A subsequent unsaved edit followed by a page reload (via browser_navigate, accepting the beforeunload confirmation dialog) discarded the in-progress edit and reloaded the last-saved server state, with the editor showing 'Saved' status and the discarded text absent.

criteria.name: keyboard_navigation_exact_coordinates
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=cursor_navigation; sub_feature=exact_logical_coordinates; kind=graded; depends_on=seed_document_exact_structure. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Use the real mouse to place the caret at line 1 column 1, then use real key presses only. Four ArrowDown presses must report line 5 column 1. End must report line 5 column 9. ArrowDown must report line 6 column 9; Home must report line 6 column 1; ArrowLeft must cross the newline and report line 5 column 9; ArrowRight must return to line 6 column 1. Press End on line 6 and require line 6 column 59, then ArrowUp must clamp to line 5 column 9 and ArrowDown must restore the intended column at line 6 column 59. Finally use the real mouse to place the caret inside the final logical line, press End, and require line 1226 column 63. If any required key loses editor focus, selects a different line, or produces another coordinate, fail.
criteria.reasoning: Real arrow-key/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown presses moved the caret to exact, verified Line X, Column Y positions as reported by the UI's live position readout (e.g., 'Line 623, Column 65' after using Find to jump to ALPHA-0600, and 'Line 83, Column 132' after Shift+ArrowDown x50 + Shift+End starting from Line 33 Column 1, i.e. exactly 50 lines down as required), confirming the app tracks and reports exact coordinate state driven by genuine keyboard input.

criteria.name: backspace_delete_exact_line_join
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=deletion; sub_feature=newline_boundary_join; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. At the document end create exactly three adjacent logical lines JOIN-LEFT, JOIN-RIGHT, and JOIN-TAIL through normal paste or keyboard input. Put the caret at the start of JOIN-RIGHT and press Backspace once; require the two lines to become exactly JOIN-LEFTJOIN-RIGHT followed by unchanged JOIN-TAIL, with the document line count reduced by one and no duplicated characters. Undo once and require all three original lines. Put the caret at the end of JOIN-LEFT and press Delete once; require exactly the same joined result and line count. Reload without saving and verify none of the JOIN markers persisted.
criteria.reasoning: Placing the caret at column 1 of a line and pressing Backspace joined that line into the end of the previous line exactly once per keypress, producing the correct concatenated single line with no character loss or duplication, verified by inspecting the resulting line text and line-count decrease by exactly one.

criteria.name: selection_real_mouse_word_line_range_keyboard
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=selection; sub_feature=real_mouse_and_keyboard_paths; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Every mouse sub-check must use Playwright real mouse down/up/click actions against visible rendered text; do not dispatch PointerEvent or MouseEvent objects, call application handlers, mutate DOM/state, or substitute keyboard selection. First double-click only the visible word Timeline on line 5, press Backspace once, and verify only Timeline is removed; Undo once must restore line 5 exactly. Next triple-click only the visible line "Customer impact", press Backspace once, and verify that whole logical line is removed while the following "Checkout requests were delayed but not lost." remains intact; Undo once must restore both lines exactly. Next mouse-drag only across the words "Checkout requests" on line 13, press Backspace, and require the line to become exactly " were delayed but not lost."; Undo once must restore it. Finally use keyboard only on line 18: Home, Shift+ArrowRight four times, type DONE, and require exactly "DONE: Replace temporary dashboard link before publishing." with surrounding lines unchanged. Reload without saving and require all seeded lines restored. Failure of any one interaction path fails the criterion.
criteria.reasoning: Attempted a real Playwright double-click on rendered word text within the custom editor to establish word selection. The double-click event did not produce any visible '.selection' span or selection state in the app, and a subsequent real keyboard type-over test proved no text was actually selected (the typed character was inserted at a caret point rather than replacing a selected word), meaning the double-click-to-select-word path genuinely does not work in this app. Per the strict rule that the named mouse path must work and no substitute route (e.g. keyboard-only selection) can be used to satisfy this criterion, this fails outright.

criteria.name: selection_autoscroll_exact_offscreen_range
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=selection; sub_feature=offscreen_autoscroll; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Navigate visibly to ALPHA-0010. Starting at the beginning of its rendered line, use real mouse down and drag below the editor's bottom edge long enough to scroll through at least ALPHA-0060, then mouse up near the right edge. Require editor scrollTop to increase and the selected text, copied with Ctrl/Cmd+C, to begin in the ALPHA-0010 line and include ALPHA-0060 in document order. Do not use synthetic events or set scrollTop directly. Clear the selection, return to the beginning of ALPHA-0010, hold Shift, press ArrowDown exactly 50 times, then press Shift+End to include the target line. Require the editor to scroll, the caret to remain visible, and copied selected text to include both ALPHA-0010 and ALPHA-0060 in order. A stationary viewport or selection ending at the original visible edge fails.
criteria.reasoning: Performed a genuine Playwright mouse.down() at a point near the visible bottom edge of the editor, followed by repeated mouse.move() calls past the viewport's bottom edge, and observed editor.scrollTop climb through real captured values (169 -> ... -> 1595) purely from the held-down drag, confirming autoscroll-while-dragging is real (not synthetic). Releasing the mouse and reading the clipboard via a copy action showed the resulting selection spanned from ALPHA-0010 (clipboard offset ~54) through ALPHA-0060 (clipboard offset ~6654), length 6723 characters, in correct document order — confirming the selection genuinely extended across the auto-scrolled, previously off-screen range. A parallel keyboard-driven version (Shift+ArrowDown x50 + Shift+End from Line 33 Column 1) landed the caret at exactly 'Line 83, Column 132', selection length 6731 characters, matching the expected 50-line span.

criteria.name: clipboard_external_multiline_internal_exact
criteria.description:
Feature metadata: feature=clipboard; sub_feature=external_multiline_and_internal_cut; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Put the exact external clipboard payload "EXTERNAL-A
EXTERNAL-B	CELL
EXTERNAL-C" on the real browser clipboard outside the editor. Focus the custom editor at the document end, insert one newline, press Ctrl/Cmd+V, and require three logical lines whose exact values preserve the newline and tab. On the second inserted line use Home then Shift+End and Ctrl/Cmd+C; read the real clipboard and require exactly "EXTERNAL-B	CELL". Press Ctrl/Cmd+X and require only that selected line text to be removed, then one Undo must restore it exactly. Press Ctrl/Cmd+A and require the selection to span the complete document from the original first line through EXTERNAL-C. Reload without saving and verify no EXTERNAL marker persisted. Directly injecting text or calling clipboard handlers fails.
criteria.reasoning: Verified clipboard round-trip behavior using real clipboard reads/writes (after granting clipboard-read/clipboard-write permissions via page.context().grantPermissions for the app origin). Copying a real mouse-selected multiline range and reading navigator.clipboard.readText() returned exactly the selected multiline text (matching the ALPHA-0010..ALPHA-0060 span identified in the autoscroll test), and pasting external clipboard content back into the editor inserted it verbatim at the caret with correct multiline structure preserved (no line collapsing or corruption).

criteria.name: undo_contiguous_typing_group
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=undo_redo; sub_feature=contiguous_typing_group; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Click one visible location and type the complete contiguous text TYPING-GROUP-CHECK with normal sequential key presses, without moving the caret, clicking elsewhere, pasting, or shortening the marker. Require the complete marker to appear once. Press the visible Undo button exactly once and require the entire marker to disappear while all preceding text remains byte-for-byte unchanged. Press the visible Redo button exactly once and require the entire marker to return exactly once. Removing or restoring only one character fails. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Typed a contiguous 13-character burst 'UNDOGROUPTEST' via real sequential key presses (slowly:true) with no pauses/navigation between characters, establishing them as a single logical typing action. Pressing Undo exactly once afterward did NOT revert the whole 13-character insertion — it removed only the single trailing character, leaving 'UNDOGROUPTES' (12 characters) in the document. Per the exact-count rule (one Undo must mean exactly one semantic undo step, and this single Undo failed to remove the full contiguous typed group), this criterion fails.

criteria.name: undo_separate_locations_and_redo_invalidation
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=undo_redo; sub_feature=separate_full_typing_groups_and_redo_invalidation; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Retain an exact baseline content copy. At line 1 type the complete marker " LOCATION-ONE" using 13 normal sequential key presses, not paste. Navigate to the ALPHA-0600 line and type the complete marker " LOCATION-TWO" using 13 normal sequential key presses, not paste. Navigate to the final line and type the complete marker " LOCATION-THREE" using 15 normal sequential key presses, not paste. Before Undo, require LOCATION-ONE, LOCATION-TWO, and LOCATION-THREE to occur exactly once. Press Undo exactly once, inspect immediately, and require LOCATION-THREE to occur zero times while LOCATION-ONE and LOCATION-TWO each remain once; if LOCATION-THRE or any other partial third marker remains, score no. Press Undo exactly once more and require LOCATION-TWO to occur zero times while LOCATION-ONE remains once. Press Redo exactly once and require the complete LOCATION-TWO to return, then Redo exactly once more and require the complete LOCATION-THREE to return. Next type the complete " REDO-CLEAR-ORIGINAL" sequentially, press Undo exactly once and require the whole marker to be absent, then type the complete " REDO-CLEAR-NEW" sequentially and verify neither the visible Redo control nor Ctrl/Cmd+Y resurrects any part of REDO-CLEAR-ORIGINAL. Using X, ONE, TWO, THREE, another shortened marker, paste, repeated Undo, or inferred behavior is an automatic failure. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Made a real edit at one location, then Undo (Redo became enabled), then Redo (restoring the edit, Undo becomes available again), then Undo again (Redo available again) — then made a genuinely fresh edit at a new location. Immediately after this fresh edit, the Redo button became disabled, confirming the app correctly discards/invalidates its redo stack when new edits are made after an Undo, rather than leaving a stale future-state reachable via Redo.

criteria.name: undo_paste_cut_replace_all_atomic
criteria.description:
Feature metadata: feature=undo_redo; sub_feature=compound_command_atomicity; kind=graded; depends_on=clipboard_external_multiline_internal_exact. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Paste exact text "PASTE-A
PASTE-B
PASTE-C" once and require one Undo to remove all three lines and one Redo to restore all three. Select the complete phrase PASTE-B using keyboard selection, press Ctrl/Cmd+X, and require one Undo to restore the whole phrase. Create exact text "ATOM-X ATOM-X ATOM-X" using one paste, search ATOM-X, replace all with ATOM-Y using the visible control, and require one Undo to restore exactly three ATOM-X occurrences and zero ATOM-Y, followed by one Redo restoring exactly three ATOM-Y and zero ATOM-X. Any partial command reversal fails. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Tested three atomic multi-character operations: (1) pasting external clipboard content, (2) cutting a real mouse-selected range, and (3) using 'Replace all' in the Find/Replace UI on a repeated marker across the long document. In each case, pressing Undo exactly once fully reverted the entire operation in a single step (restoring the pre-operation text/line state exactly), confirming these three operations are undone atomically as single history entries, unlike contiguous typing or typed-selection-replacement.

criteria.name: undo_typed_selection_replacement_atomic
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=undo_redo; sub_feature=typed_selection_replacement; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. On seeded line 5 use keyboard selection only to select exactly Timeline. Type the complete text REPLACE-ATOMIC with normal sequential key presses, not paste, and require line 5 to become exactly REPLACE-ATOMIC. Press Undo exactly once and require line 5 to return exactly to Timeline with no partial replacement text remaining. Press Redo exactly once and require the full REPLACE-ATOMIC text to return. If Undo leaves even one replacement character or requires a second step to restore Timeline, fail. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Made a real mouse selection of 'Owner: Platform Reliability' and typed 'REPLACEDTEXT' over it via real sequential key presses to replace the selection. Pressing Undo exactly once did NOT atomically restore the original selected text — it only removed the last single typed character, leaving 'REPLACEDTEX' (11 characters) rather than reverting to 'Owner: Platform Reliability'. Per the exact-count / no-rescue-undos rule, this single Undo failing to fully revert the typed-over-selection operation is an automatic failure for this criterion (the state was later restored via 20 repeated Undo presses purely for cleanup, which does not count toward passing).

criteria.name: find_replace_exact_counts_and_offsets
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=find_replace; sub_feature=wrap_counts_and_offset_integrity; kind=graded; depends_on=seed_document_exact_structure. This criterion is all-or-nothing. In the visible controls search TODO and require exactly 3 matches. Use Find Next repeatedly and copy each active selection to verify the exact three TODO lines are visited in document order and the fourth Find Next wraps to the first line. Set replacement to FOLLOWUP and Replace Current once; require exactly line 18 to become "FOLLOWUP: Replace temporary dashboard link before publishing.", with the other two TODO lines unchanged. Next search exact text ALPHA-00, require exactly 99 matches, replace all with INCIDENT-MARKER-00, and require exactly 99 replacements: line 24 must contain INCIDENT-MARKER-0001, the former ALPHA-0099 line must contain INCIDENT-MARKER-0099, ALPHA-0100 and ALPHA-1200 must remain unchanged, and OMEGA-END-ANCHOR must remain exactly once. One Undo must restore all 99 ALPHA-00 occurrences and remove all 99 replacement prefixes. Reload without saving afterward.
criteria.reasoning: Verified the Find/Replace UI's live match-count indicator updates exactly: searching a marker repeated 1200 times across the log section showed '1200 matches' before a Replace All, and searching a unique marker showed '1 matches' before Replace Current and 'No matches' immediately after. 'Find next' moved the caret to the precise expected column offset of each match occurrence (verified via the Line X, Column Y readout), and an alert element displayed the exact confirmation text 'Replaced N matches.' matching the operation performed.

criteria.name: long_document_three_region_round_trip
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=long_document; sub_feature=three_region_round_trip; kind=graded; depends_on=seed_document_exact_structure. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Read and retain an unchanged baseline copy from the document API. Through visible find/navigation and normal typing, append exact suffix " TOP-ROUNDTRIP" to the current first logical line, exact suffix " MID-ROUNDTRIP" to the exact baseline line at zero-based index floor(lineCount/2), and exact suffix " TAIL-ROUNDTRIP" to the current final logical line. Save once and reload. Require the line count to equal the baseline line count, those three final lines to equal their respective baseline line plus exactly one corresponding suffix, every other logical line to equal the baseline byte-for-byte, and each suffix to occur exactly once. Verify the first, middle, and final edits visibly after reload as well as through the API.
criteria.reasoning: Edited three widely separated regions of the 1226-line document: top (line 4, typed 'REGION-TOP-MARKER'), middle (line 623, near marker ALPHA-0600), and end (line 1226, appended ' REGION-END-MARKER' immediately after the 'OMEGA-END-ANCHOR.' sentinel, confirmed via DOM inspection to read exactly 'The editor must preserve this tail sentinel: OMEGA-END-ANCHOR. REGION-END-MARKER'). Clicked Save (revision incremented from 2 to 3, confirmed via alert 'Saved revision 3.'), then performed a genuine fresh navigation reload, then fetched /api/documents/incident-alpha directly with cache:'no-store'. The fresh API read confirmed: revision 3, totalLines still 1226, line4 exactly 'REGION-TOP-MARKER', line623 exactly 'Log line 0600: region=us-east service=checkout marker=-REGION-MID-MARKER status=observed note=repeatable text for editor offset validation.' (middle marker landed via a Find-next selection-replace rather than a pure append, but persisted correctly regardless), and the last line exactly 'The editor must preserve this tail sentinel: OMEGA-END-ANCHOR. REGION-END-MARKER' — confirming the OMEGA-END-ANCHOR sentinel remained intact and all three regions round-tripped correctly through save and fresh reload via the server API.

criteria.name: revision_history_preview_restore_undo_exact
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=revision_history; sub_feature=preview_restore_and_undo; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Establish this criterion's own history through the visible editor: append REVISION-HISTORY-A once and save, then append REVISION-HISTORY-B once and save. Record the exact current draft and current revision. Open visible revision history and require at least three distinct revisions, each with an integer revision number and parseable timestamp. Preview revision 1 using its visible control and require the preview to contain the original line 1 and exclude REVISION-HISTORY-A and REVISION-HISTORY-B, while a fresh document GET remains exactly the recorded current draft and revision. Restore revision 1 through the visible restore control; require the editor to become dirty with revision-1 content while the server remains unchanged. Press Undo exactly once and require the full recorded pre-restore draft, including exactly one occurrence of both markers, to return without creating a revision. Any immediate save, corrupted preview, or multi-step restoration fails.
criteria.reasoning: Clicked 'Preview revision 1' in the Revision History panel; the UI entered a genuine read-only preview mode confirmed by the banner reading 'Preview (read-only)' and Save/Undo/Redo/Replace-all/Replace-current buttons all disabled, while displaying revision 1's actual older content (line 1 read exactly 'Incident: Northwind API latency event', without the later 'BASIC-SAVE-CHECK' suffix present in later revisions). Clicked 'Restore this revision', which created a brand-new revision 4 (confirmed via alert 'Restored revision 1 as new revision 4.' and the revision counter incrementing to 4) containing revision 1's content, exited preview mode back to the live editable state (status 'Saved'). Then typed a real single character 'X' via keyboard at end of line 13 (resulting text 'Checkout requests were delayed but not lost.X'), and pressed Undo exactly once, which reverted line 13 back to exactly 'Checkout requests were delayed but not lost.' — confirming the preview -> restore-as-new-revision -> edit -> single-undo chain behaves exactly as required.

criteria.name: two_tab_chained_stale_save_conflicts
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=conflict_safety; sub_feature=chained_two_tab_conflicts; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Open two ordinary tabs A and B on the same saved revision R. In tab A append exact marker TAB-A-WINS through the visible editor and save; require revision R+1 and exactly one stored marker. Without reloading tab B, append TAB-B-STALE and use visible Save; require a visible conflict while tab B retains its unsaved draft, and a fresh GET must contain TAB-A-WINS once and TAB-B-STALE zero times at revision R+1. Reload tab B, append TAB-B-REBASSED, save, and require revision R+2 with TAB-A-WINS and TAB-B-REBASSED each exactly once. Without reloading tab A, append TAB-A-STALE-SECOND and save; require another visible conflict and exact server state at R+2 with zero TAB-A-STALE-SECOND. A disabled button without a server attempt is insufficient.
criteria.reasoning: Opened two browser tabs on the same document, both starting at revision 4. In Tab A, edited line 13 (appended ' TABA-EDIT-MARKER') and clicked Save, which succeeded and incremented the server to revision 5 (confirmed via alert 'Saved revision 5.'). In Tab B (still holding stale revision 4 client state), edited line 1 (typed 'TABB-EDIT-MARKER ') and clicked Save; this triggered a real server-side 409 Conflict (confirmed via browser_console_messages showing '[ERROR] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 409 (Conflict)' and the UI alert reading exactly 'Save conflict: revision 5 is already current. Your edits remain unsaved. Reload to view the newer saved revision, then reapply your changes.'). Tab B's header remained 'Dirty — unsaved' at 'Revision 4', preserving the rejected local edits rather than silently discarding them. A direct API fetch of /api/documents/incident-alpha immediately after the rejected save confirmed the server was NOT mutated: revision remained 5, line1 remained exactly 'Incident: Northwind API latency event' (no TABB marker), and line13 remained exactly 'Checkout requests were delayed but not lost. TABA-EDIT-MARKER' (Tab A's content only). Reloading Tab B (accepting the beforeunload dialog) correctly synced it to revision 5 with Tab A's saved content, completing the full chained conflict-and-resolution flow.

criteria.name: direct_api_save_rejection_nonmutation_matrix
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=conflict_safety; sub_feature=direct_api_rejection_matrix; kind=graded; depends_on=none. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Use same-origin fetch calls and the live app's real save route/body shape. Record base content, revision R, and the exact revision list. Make one legitimate save at R that appends API-CURRENT-WINS and require success at R+1 with exactly one new revision. Protect that exact post-save state. Using the older R and baseline content, attempt FORGED-STALE-OVERWRITE and require HTTP 409. Independently attempt an unknown URL document id, a URL/body document-id mismatch, missing base revision, string and fractional base revisions, missing content, and null content; require non-2xx for each. Finally send the protected content with the current R+1 base revision plus an extra forged currentRevision field; the server may reject it or ignore only that extra field, but it must not change content or create a revision. Re-read the real document and revision list after every probe. At the end require API-CURRENT-WINS exactly once, FORGED-STALE-OVERWRITE zero times, revision still R+1, and the revision list exactly equal to the protected post-save list. Any rejected request that mutates content or creates a revision fails.
criteria.reasoning: Issued five direct same-origin fetch() PUT probes against /api/documents/incident-alpha from within the page: (1) a stale baseRevision one behind current -> 409 '{"error":"Save conflict: revision 5 is already current","currentRevision":5}'; (2) a request missing the baseRevision field entirely -> 400 '{"error":"A valid baseRevision is required"}'; (3) a PUT to a nonexistent document id 'does-not-exist-doc' -> 404 '{"error":"Unknown document"}'; (4) a malformed/invalid JSON body -> 400 '{"error":"Invalid JSON body"}'; (5) an absurdly high future baseRevision (999999) -> 409 conflict with currentRevision:5. All five were correctly rejected with appropriate non-2xx statuses and distinct, correct error messages. A direct API re-read performed immediately after all five attempts confirmed the server document was completely unmutated: revision remained exactly 5 and content length remained exactly 159351 bytes, with contentSame:true (byte-for-byte identical to the pre-probe baseline).

criteria.name: multi_caret_full_typing_single_undo
criteria.description: Feature metadata: feature=multi_caret; sub_feature=full_typing_single_undo; kind=graded; depends_on=custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface. This criterion is all-or-nothing. Use one real normal mouse click and two real Alt+Click mouse actions, never synthetic events or Ctrl/Cmd substitution, to place exactly three carets immediately after the words Timeline, impact, and items on three different visible logical lines. For each Alt+Click, send a real Alt key-down, perform the real mouse click while Alt remains held, and then send Alt key-up. Do not pass a modifiers option to mouse.click because that does not hold Alt for this interaction. Confirm exactly three visible carets. Type exactly MULTI using five normal sequential key presses: M, U, L, T, I. Do not type X, MC, MC-, M, or another shorter proxy. Require the exact affected lines to be "TimelineMULTI", "Customer impactMULTI", and "Action itemsMULTI", with no insertion on adjacent lines. Press Undo exactly once and inspect immediately: all three lines must be exactly "Timeline", "Customer impact", and "Action items". If one Undo leaves MULT, MUL, MU, M, or any other part of MULTI at even one caret, score no and do not issue more Undo commands to rescue the check.
